source: Reported by the Zyqora team from their training run (MacBook Air M3, PyTorch MPS); reproduced on the Raspberry Pi 5 (below). Development validation results, NOT independent TEST or official hackathon results.
limitations: Two trained classes only (Organic, Recyclable); no Residual class.
Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities; calibration has not been measured.
A confidence threshold does not reliably detect items outside the two classes.
Raspberry Pi latency, CPU and memory must be measured on the Pi (scripts/benchmark_pi.py).

pi_reproduction.source: run_zyqora.py --profile waste_mobilenetv2 on Raspberry Pi 5 Model B Rev 1.1 (2026-11-14), ExecuTorch 1.3.1+cpu, XNNPACK, 2 threads; the same 2,000 validation images. Not independent of model selection.
pi_reproduction.note: 1 image fewer correct than the MacBook run (1,932 vs 1,933, an Organic image); likely a boundary case (MPS vs XNNPACK numerics or EXIF handling).
